title: 943. Prison Cells After N Days

examples.explanation: After seven daily updates the row settles into [0,0,1,1,0,0,0,0].
A single update turns each interior cell on exactly when its two neighbours match.
Two updates in a row propagate the single gap across the row.

hints: Only 256 row layouts exist, so the evolution must eventually loop.
Record the first day each layout appears; on a repeat, skip whole cycles at once.
The two border cells always clear to 0 after day one.
